network, port, protocol or fingerprint.

Use when the user wants to see the records themselves: "show me the events from

tools.name: fingerprint_search_tool
tools.description:
Events and sources that carried one client fingerprint in a time window.

Use for "have you seen this JA4", "which IPs share this TLS fingerprint",
"find every scanner with this SSH client fingerprint". For how widespread a
fingerprint is and whether it is one operation or a common client, use
finge

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ioc_lookup_tool, payload_search_tool, fingerprint_search_tool, udp_activity_tool, interactive_sessions_tool · Private data: search_events_tool, ioc_lookup_tool, attack_timeline_tool, fingerprint_search_tool, fingerprint_similar_tool, fingerprint_population_tool, interactive_credentials_tool, interactive_files_tool, interactive_sessions_tool · Public sink: search_events_tool, fingerprint_search_tool, fingerprint_similar_tool, fingerprint_population_tool, interactive_files_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ioc_lookup_tool, payload_search_tool, fingerprint_search_tool, udp_activity_tool, interactive_sessions_tool · Private data: search_events_tool, ioc_lookup_tool, attack_timeline_tool, fingerprint_search_tool, fingerprint_similar_tool, fingerprint_population_tool, interactive_credentials_tool, interactive_files_tool, interactive_sessions_tool · Public sink: search_events_tool, fingerprint_search_tool, fingerprint_similar_tool, fingerprint_population_tool, interactive_files_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
